method.autoScope: Each service job is one independent asset. Shared two-image request is treated as one two-frame asset with equal delays, not as two equally weighted wall assets.
method.candidate: Research-only centroid and shared-target subset swaps initialized from the unchanged current Auto64 per-asset cap; all mean/strict/rare variants retained.
method.timing: Three sequential cold core trials; medians exclude worker transfer, import decode and UI. Candidate total includes all three guards; service ms is one network roundtrip and server processing, not compute-only or an equivalent benchmark.
method.alpha: Binary/opaque art uses Cut128. Partial-alpha controls use Keep eligibility1, preserving alpha. Hidden RGB is excluded from output equality and all quality metrics.
method.objective: Independent full-source point squared Oklab distance, frame-delay weighted; also original source-RGB group error/previous exact loss. Mean error is not a perceptual or semantic quality ranking.

websiteRestCount2.scope: One retained numeric2 None gradient job through each transport; not a general algorithm equivalence claim.
